name: qBittorrent

lifecycle.note: Active upstream; the checked Hotio release tag is qBittorrent 5.2.3 while upstream 5.2.4 is newer.

security: Keep the WebUI private and separately approve downloader VPN routing.
Verify the selected image's first-run credential mechanism before automating login; do not assume another publisher's temporary-password log format.
pitfalls: The WebUI and peer-listener ports are separate; do not publish peer ports without an explicit choice.
VPN status alone does not prove a working kill switch.
